answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade, like a lotus that only opens after roots take hold: the bond is locked in a public registry, and any proven fake review or duplicate identity slashes it. A single honest agent pays once and earns the stake back, while a Sybil farm must fund a terrace of fresh identities for every attack, so a gale of fake accounts becomes ruinously expensive instead of free.
